architecture.seven_concept: seven logits in frozen concept order
architecture.joint_soft: seven sigmoid concepts into linear 7-to-1 diagnosis head
architecture.joint_hard_ste: seven exact binary concepts into linear 7-to-1 diagnosis head; STE used only during training
architecture.sequential_and_oracle_heads: saved logistic regression with intercept; no refitting

metrics.macro_f1: unweighted mean of class-0 and class-1 F1, zero_division=0
metrics.undefined: null with explicit reason; never silently omit an undefined concept from a macro mean
metrics.reporting: factual differences only; no winner/rank labels

random_error_oracle.selection: uniform permutation without replacement of original threshold errors

confidently_wrong_oracle.selection: remaining original threshold error maximizing abs(original q - 0.5)

active.selection: unqueried concept maximizing score; recompute impact against current cumulative state
active.queries: seven distinct concepts including threshold-correct concepts

metrics.diagnosis: all seven frozen diagnosis metrics at each budget
metrics.query_precision: cumulative errors corrected / cumulative actual queries; null when no queries
metrics.improvement: originally wrong now correct / originally wrong
metrics.harm: originally correct now wrong / originally correct
metrics.random_summary: mean and sample SD (ddof=1) over 100 per-repetition metrics; never metrics of averaged predictions
metrics.curve_area: unnormalized trapezoid over budgets 0..7 for AUROC, Macro-F1, accuracy; per-repetition area then mean/sample SD; descriptive only

bootstrap.sampling: sort each class by lexicographic case_num; for each replicate draw 50 positives then 115 negatives with replacement; concatenate; same indices across all six models
bootstrap.paired_differences: all 15 unordered pairs in diagnosis_model_order; earlier model minus later model on identical replicate indices
bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive case-level intervals conditional on fitted models; no multiplicity-adjusted or patient-independent claim; no model changes

limitations: sequential head trained on single-model OOF features but test features average four models
joint fixed-0.5 threshold/calibration behavior accepted unchanged
oracle is non-deployable upper-bound analysis, not guaranteed empirical ceiling
simulated corrections assume perfect concept truth
execution_gate: Separate final-test authorization and verified hashes/identity for all 16 Drive checkpoints required before test exposure. No training, model choice, losses, mappings, thresholds, calibration or policies may change.
